Botox in Jaipur | Anti-Wrinkle Injections

Botox is the best-known brand of botulinum toxin, a medicine that relaxes the muscles behind expression lines such as frown lines, forehead lines and crow's feet. Injected in tiny amounts, it softens these lines while keeping natural movement. At Kezza, anti-wrinkle injections are given by our aesthetic doctors at our Jaipur clinic.

How It Works

How Do Anti-Wrinkle Injections Work?

Expression lines form where muscles contract again and again under the skin, such as between the eyebrows when you frown or around the eyes when you smile. Botulinum toxin blocks the signal from the nerve to the muscle, so the treated muscle relaxes and the skin over it smooths out.

The injections work best on dynamic lines, the ones that appear when you move your face. Lines that are visible even when your face is still may soften, but they often need other treatments too, such as fillers or skin resurfacing. The effect wears off as the nerve signals return, so treatment is repeated to maintain it.

Several brands of botulinum toxin type A are used around the world, including Botox, Dysport and Xeomin. Their doses are not interchangeable, so your doctor plans the number of units for the product used and for the strength of your muscles.

In Short:

  • Relaxes muscles: that cause expression lines.
  • Works in days: with the full effect in about two weeks.
  • Temporary: usually lasts about three to four months.
Areas

Areas Commonly Treated

Frown Lines

The vertical '11' lines between the eyebrows that deepen when you frown or concentrate.

Forehead Lines

Horizontal lines across the forehead, treated with care so the brows do not feel heavy.

Crow's Feet

Lines at the outer corners of the eyes that show when you smile or squint.

Jawline (Masseter)

Relaxing a strong jaw muscle can soften a square jaw; this is planned carefully by the doctor.

Natural Movement

Doses are planned to soften lines while keeping your expressions, not to freeze the face.

Doctor-Given

Injections are planned and given by our aesthetic doctors after a face assessment.

Suitability

Are Anti-Wrinkle Injections Right for You?

They suit healthy adults with expression lines who want a subtle, temporary change.

Injections may suit you if

  • You have lines that appear when you frown, raise your brows or smile
  • You notice early lines and would like to soften them
  • You prefer a subtle result that keeps natural expressions
  • You understand the effect is temporary and needs repeat treatment

They are not suitable, or need care, if

  • You are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • You have a nerve or muscle condition such as myasthenia gravis, or already have drooping eyelids or weak facial muscles
  • You have an infection or inflamed skin where the injections would go
  • You take blood thinners or have had botulinum toxin in the last few months; tell your doctor first

Deeper folds and lost volume, for example under the eyes, are treated differently. See our dark circles treatment page, or ask about fillers at your consultation.

Procedure

What Happens at Your Appointment

The injections take only a few minutes; most of the visit is the assessment and planning.

01

Face Assessment

Your doctor looks at your lines at rest and in movement, checks your medical history and medicines, and discusses the look you want.

02

Planning the Doses

The injection points and the number of units are planned for each area and marked on the skin.

03

Cleansing & Comfort

The skin is cleaned, and ice or a numbing cream can be used if you are sensitive.

04

Injections

Tiny amounts are injected with a very fine needle; each area takes a few minutes.

05

Aftercare & Review

You get simple aftercare advice, and a review at about two weeks checks the result.

Timeline

Anti-Wrinkle Injection Timeline

The effect builds over days and fades gradually over months.

D1

Injection Day

Small bumps at the injection points settle quickly; a tiny bruise is possible.

D3

Days 1 to 4

The effect starts to show as the muscles relax.

W2

Around Two Weeks

The full result is visible, and a review can fine-tune it if needed.

M3

Three to Four Months

Movement gradually returns as the effect wears off.

M4

Repeat Treatment

A repeat session keeps the lines soft; many people repeat every few months.

Medical Note: Results vary from person to person. This page is general information from Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic and is not a substitute for a consultation with a doctor.

What anti-wrinkle injections can and cannot do

Botulinum toxin is very good at softening lines caused by movement, especially frown lines, forehead lines and crow's feet. It does not add volume, lift sagging skin or change skin texture and pigmentation. Hollows under the eyes, deep folds from the nose to the mouth and loose skin on the jaw are usually better treated with fillers, skin-tightening treatments or other options. At your consultation, your doctor will explain honestly which of your concerns injections can help with and which need a different approach.

Safety and choosing where to be treated

Botulinum toxin is a prescription medicine, and the dose, the product and the exact injection points all matter. Mayo Clinic lists pain, swelling or bruising at the injection site, headache and flu-like symptoms as common side effects, and droopy eyelids or uneven eyebrows as possible effects when the medicine reaches nearby muscles. Rarely, the effect can spread beyond the treated area. Being treated by a trained doctor who knows facial anatomy, in a clinic that can manage side effects, lowers these risks. Always tell your doctor about your medicines, recent treatments and any nerve or muscle conditions.

Tips for your first treatment

  • Book your first treatment at least two weeks before an important event, so the full result and any review are done in time.
  • Avoid alcohol and, if your doctor agrees, medicines that increase bruising for a day or two beforehand. Do not stop prescribed medicines without asking.
  • Come without makeup on the areas to be treated.
  • Bring photos if you have a particular look in mind, or of how you looked a few years ago.

Aftercare

You can return to most activities straight away. Cleveland Clinic advises not rubbing or pressing on the treated area for 12 hours, staying upright for three to four hours and avoiding strenuous exercise for 24 hours. If you can, wait until the next day for makeup, or apply it lightly without rubbing. If you notice a drooping eyelid or uneven brows as the effect develops, contact the clinic, because some effects can be adjusted at your review.

What affects the cost of anti-wrinkle injections?

The cost depends on the number of areas treated, the dose each area needs and the product used. Treating one area, such as frown lines, costs less than treating the forehead, frown lines and crow's feet together. Your doctor explains the plan and the total before any injection.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does Botox last?
For most people the effect lasts about three to four months, according to Mayo Clinic, and some people find it lasts a little longer. Movement returns gradually, and the lines slowly return to how they looked before treatment.
When will I see the results?
Mayo Clinic notes that the injections usually begin working 1 to 3 days after treatment, and the full result can take a week or more. Cleveland Clinic says full results are visible within 10 to 14 days, which is why reviews are booked at about two weeks.
Does it hurt?
The needle is very fine and each injection takes seconds, so most people feel only a quick pinch. Ice or numbing cream can be used if you are sensitive. You may have small bumps or redness at the injection points for a short time.
Will I look frozen?
Not when the dose is planned for your face. The aim is to soften lines while keeping natural expressions. If you prefer a lighter effect, your doctor can start with a lower dose and review it at two weeks.
What are the side effects?
Common side effects are mild pain, swelling or bruising at the injection sites, and sometimes a headache or flu-like feeling. Less often, the medicine can affect nearby muscles and cause a drooping eyelid or uneven eyebrows, which is temporary. Rarely, the effect spreads further; seek urgent care for muscle weakness, any difficulty breathing, swallowing or speaking, or vision problems.
What should I avoid after the injections?
Cleveland Clinic advises not rubbing or putting pressure on the treated area for 12 hours, staying upright for three to four hours, and avoiding strenuous exercise for 24 hours. You can usually go back to work straight away.
